mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_call ( agent_run_id, request_id, connection_id, model_profile_id, connection_name_snapshot, model_name_snapshot, protocol, streaming, status, started_at, finished_at, input_token_count, output_token_count, cached_token_count, provider_request_id, previous_response_id, error_code, error_summary, retry_count, created_at ) VALUES ( #{agentRunId}, #{requestId}, #{connectionId}, #{modelProfileId}, #{connectionNameSnapshot}, #{modelNameSnapshot}, #{protocol}, #{streaming}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{inputTokenCount}, #{outputTokenCount}, #{cachedTokenCount}, #{providerRequestId}, #{previousResponseId}, #{errorCode}, #{errorSummary}, #{retryCount}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, agent_run_id, request_id, connection_id, model_profile_id, connection_name_snapshot, model_name_snapshot, protocol, streaming, status, started_at, finished_at, input_token_count, output_token_count, cached_token_count, provider_request_id, previous_response_id, error_code, error_summary, retry_count, created_at FROM model_call WHERE agent_run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE model_call SET status = #{status}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, provider_request_id = #{providerRequestId}, input_token_count = #{inputTokenCount}, output_token_count = #{outputTokenCount}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE model_call SET status = #{status}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary} WHERE agent_run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
